step1_analysis.description: An active proportional-integral (PI) loop filter used in a PLL to convert differential charge pump current into a fine-tuning voltage for the VCO. It features a second-order passive RC network in the feedback path of a differential amplifier.

paper_reference.title: Modeling, Design and Characterization of a New Low-Jitter Analog Dual Tuning LC-VCO PLL Architecture

transimpedance_1kHz.description: Transimpedance gain in the low-frequency integrator region

sky130_expected.calculation: Z = 1 / (2*pi*f*C4) * 2 (differential). For C4=1nF, f=1kHz, Z = 318kOhm -> 110 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on chosen loop filter capacitor values for the PLL bandwidth. Dominates the DC tracking behavior.

transimpedance_100kHz.description: Transimpedance gain in the proportional (resistive) region

sky130_expected.calculation: Z = 2 * R1. For R1=10kOhm, Z = 20kOhm -> 86 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determines the damping factor and phase margin of the PLL.

transimpedance_10MHz.description: Transimpedance gain in the high-frequency suppression region

sky130_expected.calculation: Z = 1 / (2*pi*f*C1) * 2. For C1=100pF, f=10MHz, Z = 318 Ohm -> 50 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determines the suppression of reference spurs and high-frequency noise.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the transimpedance profile of the active loop filter across integrator, resistive, and high-frequency pole regions.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Active Differential Loop Filter Testbench

* DUT (Modified A1 to X1 and added typical component values for simulation)
X1 Vfinen Vfinep CHPoutp CHPoutn amplifier
R1 CHPoutn N5 10k
C1 CHPoutn Vfinep 100p
C2 CHPoutp Vfinen 100p
C3 Vfinen N4 1n
C4 Vfinep N5 1n
R2 CHPoutp N4 10k

* Ideal Differential Amplifier Subcircuit
.subckt amplifier outn outp inp inn
E1 outp 0 inp inn 10000
E2 outn 0 inn inp 10000
.ends

* Stimulus (Differential Current from Charge Pump)
I1 0 CHPoutp AC 1
I2 0 CHPoutn AC -1

* DC bias paths for the ideal op-amp inputs to prevent floating nodes
Rcm1 CHPoutp 0 1G
Rcm2 CHPoutn 0 1G

.control
ac dec 20 100 100MEG

* Calculate differential transimpedance (Z = Vdiff / Idiff)
* Idiff = I1 - I2 = 2A
let vout_diff = v(Vfinep) - v(Vfinen)
let z_diff = mag(vout_diff) / 2
let z_db = 20*log10(z_diff)

* Measure transimpedance at different regions
meas ac z_1k find z_db at=1k
meas ac z_100k find z_db at=100k
meas ac z_10meg find z_db at=10meg

print z_1k z_100k z_10meg
quit
.endc
.end
